Body.Content:
The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

GA date: November CY2026
